title: Lot Outline (display-only EPSG:4326)
description: Closed display-only EPSG:4326 tax-lot outline contract. Version 1.0.0 transports NYC DCP MapPLUTO; additive 1.1.0 also admits NYC DOF Digital Tax Map outlines from an explicitly selected source. Coordinates are transported verbatim for drawing, never measurement, legal zoning-lot determination, parcel merger, or a buildable envelope. The authoritative EPSG:2263 measurement path is unchanged. Four typed outcomes preserve missing, invalid, and ambiguous data without invented geometry. Each outcome carries source-specific provenance, accuracy notes, attribution, and disclaimers; the MapPLUTO tolerance is not asserted for DOF.

contract_version.description: Published versions: 1.0.0 MapPLUTO; additive 1.1.0 admits explicitly selected DOF Digital Tax Map display outlines while retaining older payloads.

bbl.description: The requested lot, echoed in canonical 10-digit form (derived ONLY from normalize_bbl; never interpolated from raw caller input).

outcome.description: The typed outline outcome. single_lot = one feature with a valid Polygon/MultiPolygon outline. no_outline = zero features (condo unit lot with no polygon, or no lot for this BBL); see no_outline_reason. multiple_features = more than one feature for one BBL (REVIEW REQUIRED; geometry withheld, never a silent first-pick). invalid_geometry = a feature whose geometry is null/empty/non-polygon (typed, never an error).

display_only.description: Always true. This outline is transport for DISPLAY ONLY; no measurement is derived from its EPSG:4326 coordinates. Measurement is owned solely by the authoritative EPSG:2263 path.

crs.description: The coordinate reference system of geometry.coordinates: always EPSG:4326 (WGS84 longitude/latitude degrees), obtained by the official service's outSR=4326 server-side reprojection and asserted against the response CRS member before any coordinate is transported.

geometry.description: The GeoJSON outline geometry in EPSG:4326 lng/lat, present ONLY on a single_lot outcome; null on every other outcome (no fabricated or first-pick geometry ever travels). Coordinates are verbatim from the official service (never re-rounded here).

feature_count.description: Number of official features the bounded query returned for this BBL (0 for no_outline, 1 for single_lot/invalid_geometry, >1 for multiple_features).

review_required.description: True when a qualified human must resolve the outcome before it can be trusted (multiple_features). Deterministic, never an AI decision.

no_outline_reason.description: On a no_outline outcome, the typed reason: condo_unit_lot_no_polygon (a condominium unit lot 1001-6999 carries no MapPLUTO polygon - resolve the billing BBL) or no_feature_for_bbl (the official service returned zero features for this BBL). null on every other outcome.

lot_identity.description: Borough/block/lot identity transported verbatim from the returned feature's attributes on a single_lot outcome; null otherwise. Display context only; never used for measurement.

accuracy_note.description: Source-specific accuracy and display-only limitations. MapPLUTO carries its existing plus-or-minus 20 ft statement; DOF has no numerical tolerance established here. Never transfer one source tolerance to another.

attribution.description: Attribution to the agency and dataset actually supplying this outline.

disclaimer.description: Source-specific informational-use disclaimer and boundary-survey limitation.

notes.description: Human-readable notes for the outcome (condo semantics, review cause, invalid-geometry reason). Never a substitute for the machine-readable fields above.

_expected_failure.description: FIXTURE-ONLY annotation stating the intended defect of an invalid contract fixture (packages/contracts README convention). The builder NEVER emits this key; it is allowed (optional) so an invalid fixture fails only for its stated defect under additionalProperties:false, and valid fixtures - which omit it - stay clean.

position.description: A GeoJSON position: [longitude, latitude] in EPSG:4326 degrees, exactly two ordinates (this service emits 2D coordinates).

linear_ring.description: A closed GeoJSON linear ring (first and last positions equal): at least four positions.

polygon_geometry.description: A GeoJSON Polygon: the first ring is the exterior boundary, any further rings are holes.

multipolygon_geometry.description: A GeoJSON MultiPolygon: an array of polygons (each an array of rings). Shoreline-clipped lots produce true multipolygons.

outline_geometry.description: A GeoJSON Polygon or MultiPolygon, or null when no outline is surfaced.

condo_classification.description: Source-specific identity description. MapPLUTO retains its billing/unit semantics. DOF exact tax-lot polygons use standard_lot without asserting a legal zoning-lot status; CONDO_FLAG=C is preserved in the note and does not identify the polygon as a unit or whole complex.

lot_identity.description: Borough/block/lot identity transported verbatim from the returned feature's attributes.

source_provenance.description: Provenance of the selected official display source: exact bounded query URL, source identity, retrieval timestamp, and actual dataset release if exposed. DOF EFFECTIVE_TAX_YEAR is not a dataset release; its dataset_version remains null.

endpoint.description: The exact bounded FeatureServer query URL (f=geojson&outSR=4326) this outline was transported from.

dataset_version.description: Actual dataset release identifier, if exposed. MapPLUTO Version is preserved. DOF Digital Tax Map does not expose a release identifier in these features, so null; effective tax year is preserved only as a source attribute.

retrieved_at.description: RFC 3339 retrieval timestamp of the transport request.
